svg.title: EVM0x / terminal alter ego
svg.desc: A black terminal card. A binary-rain portrait of the EVM0x avatar, drawn from 0 and 1 characters at varying grey levels with lime highlights, sits in the left column and periodically dissolves into the number 69 before reforming. To its right, a lime prompt reads evm0x@localhost:~$ ./whoami, followed by a dotted field list: role Web3 dev, bot engineer and AI agent builder; focus autonomous agents, onchain apps and trading bots; shipped Squeek Pack, splitmon, poker-bot; next Arena Kuru THE SNIPER; code Python, TypeScript, Solidity, Bash; low level EVM bytecode and calldata decoding; chain tools Foundry, Hardhat, ethers, web3.py; bot tools Python async, Playwright, Telegram; LLMs [OI], Anthropic, Ollama; agent frameworks LangChain and MCP; protocols MCP servers, x402, ERC-8004; runtime systemd, Docker, cron, tailscale; platforms EVM, BSC, Base, Monad, Solana; practice live agents; notes KTL DAO; 31 public repos and 35 stars, checked 2026-11-16 UTC. Footer: Every block is a clue.
